name: version-sentinel
description: Warns about dependency version checks and recommends upstream verification. Never blocks tools.

disable.title: Turn off Version Sentinel (kill switch)
disable.description: Default: false — advisory warnings are active. Set true to suppress hook warnings. Hooks never block tools even when enabled. VS_DISABLE in your shell overrides this setting.

window_hours.title: How long a recorded version check stays valid (hours)
window_hours.description: Default: 24 hours (minimum 1, maximum 168). Expired checks can produce advisory warnings; work remains allowed. Lower it for more frequent reminders or raise it to reuse evidence longer.

security_npm_audit.title: Check resolved npm dependencies with npm audit
security_npm_audit.description: Default: true. Check package-lock.json v2/v3 resolved registry packages, including transitive, development, optional and peer dependencies. High/critical advisories and unknown/incomplete enabled checks warn about dependency work. Set false to disable this provider explicitly; it does not disable OSV. VS_SECURITY_NPM_AUDIT overrides this setting. Scans send dependency information to the configured npm registry.

security_osv.title: Check npm versions with OSV
security_osv.description: Default: true. Check proposed exact npm versions and supported resolved package-lock trees with OSV. High/critical advisories, unknown severity and incomplete enabled checks warn about dependency work. Set false to disable this provider explicitly; it does not disable npm audit. VS_SECURITY_OSV overrides this setting. Package names and versions are sent to the public OSV API.
